tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub kyi bsdus don 'phrin las kun khyab bzhugs// na mo badz+ra kī la ya/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon dang dbyer med pa'i dpal 'phrin las phur bu'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyis lta ba'i sgro 'dogs chod/ /dkyil 'khor gsum gyis tha mal snang zhen 'gags/ /mchod pa bdun gyis tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed pa'i/ /lam mchog 'di yi gar 'chams don bsdus bri/ /de la 'dir rdo rje phur pa dngos grub char 'bebs kyi bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams kyi 'cham yig snang ba 'gyur thub kyi don bsdus brjed byang du gdab pa la/ thog mar pad 'gros la rol mo gcig brdeg yang pad ji ltar rigs pa dang mjug tu rol 'gros/ sa gzhi kho snyoms la rol mo gcig brdeg pad skor bzhi pad bya ste lus kyi dbus g.yas phyogs/ yang dbus g.yon phyogs/ slar dbus dang lngar pad skor byed pa ste 'og nas bzhi pad bya zhes pa kun la 'di'i rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /pad skor rdzogs nas 'cham dngos/ mjug tu rol 'gros/ chos kyi dbyings bskyed pa la rol pa gcig brdeg gong bzhin bzhi pad bya/ bsdu tshul/ 'cham dngos/ mchongs pad bya ste pad skor lus kyi dbus g.yon/ yang dbus g.yas rnams su byed pa ste 'og nas mchongs pad bya zhes pa kun la des rigs 'gre bas pad skor bzhi bzhi byed pa kho na'o/ /de nas mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ snang srid dbang bsdud la rol pa gcig brdeg de nas mchongs pad dang 'chams dngos/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ mkha' 'gro dpa' bskyed pa la rol pa gcig brdeg bzhi pad/ bsdu tshul/ 'cham dngos/ 'jol stabs/ mchongs pad mchong rjes bskyod 'gros/ bsrung ma 'bod pa la rol pa gcig brdeg bzhi pad/ bsdu tshul/ 'cham dngos/ 'jol stabs/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ dam nyams bla 'gug pa la rol pa gcig brdeg

bzhi pad/ bsdu tshul/ 'cham dngos/ 'jol stabs/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ steng 'og bar gsum byin gyis brlabs pa la rol pa gcig brdeg pad skor bzhi bca' phyed ma bya ste bzhi pad kyi pad skor bzhi pa g.yon gyi dus su rol mo che ba dang bstun g.yas log yang pad skor lnga pa dbus kyi pad skor dang bstun g.yon log de ltar g.yas log g.yon log grub mtshams 'cham dngos/ 'jol stabs/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ rdo rje phyed pa la rol pa gcig brdeg der rjes rol mo bzhi brdeg bzhi brdungs pa dang bstun pa'i mchong pad bya/ de nas 'cham dngos/ ldem 'gros bzhi brdeg rdo rje rkyang 'gros la rol pa bzhi brdeg de nas rol mo bzhi brdungs dang bstun bzhi pad/ pad skor gsum pa'i dus su g.yas log pad skor bzhi pa'i dusasu g.yon log pad skor lnga pa'i tshe yang g.yas log de nas 'cham dngos/ ldem 'gros bzhi brdeg rdo rje rgya gram la rol pa bzhi brdeg mchongs pad/ 'cham dngos/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ e las mkha' dbyings la rol pa gcig brdeg der rjes rol mo bzhi brdeg bzhi pad/ dzam g.yas su gnon pa dang / 'cham dngos/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes ldem 'gros gcig brdeg yam̐ las rlung chen la rol pa gcig brdeg de rjes rol mo lnga brdeg bzhi pad/ dzam g.yas su gnon/ 'chams dngos/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes ldem 'gros gcig brdeg de steng wam̐ las chu dkyil la rol pa gcig brdeg der rjes rol mo lnga brdeg bzhi pad/ dzam g.yon du gnon/ 'cham dngos/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes ldem 'gros gcig brdeg ram̐ las me byung bskyed pa la rol pa gcig brdeg der rjes rol mo bzhi brdeg mchongs pad/ 'cham dngos/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes ldem 'gros bzhi brdeg lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor brtan pa la rol pa bzhi brdeg mchongs pad/ 'cham dngos/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes ldem 'gros bzhi brdeg

de steng rak+ta'i rgya mtsho la rol pa/ bzhi brdeg mchongs pad/ 'cham dngos/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes ldem 'gros bzhi brdeg dbus su keng rus ri rab la rol pa bzhi brdeg mchongs pad/ 'cham dngos/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ rin chen lnga las grub pa'i gzhal med khang la rol pa gcig brdeg der rjes rol mo gnyis brdeg 'then rkang 'dra ba dang / mchongs pad/ 'cham dngos la rdul tshon 'thor ba'i tshul dang / yang mchongs pad/ rdul tshon snyoms me snyoms blta ba dang / sgo 'bri ba'i mtshams rnams su 'jol stabs dang / byang sgo'i 'jol stabs rjes su gong bzhin mchongs tshar ba dang / mchongs pad mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ 'di yan la snang srid dbang bsdud dang / mkha' 'gro dpa' bskyed pa gnyis la 'cham dngos gzhi'i gong pad skor la mchongs pad de pad skor bzhi dang / bzhi pad de pad skor lnga nges par dgos shing / steng 'og bar gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ rdo rje rkyang 'gros rnams la yang bzhi pad nges par bya la/ gzhan ma rnams la pad skor gnyis gsum sogs longs skabs dang sbyar nas mdzad pa phyag len yin pas thams cad kyis 'cham dpon la ma yengs par bltas te 'grig par bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bskyed nas bzung 'og byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar dang / e las mkha' dbyings rnams la so so'i dngos gzhi'i 'cham rdzogs mtshams 'jol stabs dang / dpal chen mo man gyi so so'i dngos gzhi'i 'cham grub mtshams grol bsdu yin pas de ltar du shes par bya'o/ /de nas dpal chen po'i 'gying chen 'gying chung gnyis la rol pa gcig brdeg pad skor bzhi pad/ bsdu tshul/ 'cham dngos/ grol bsdu/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes ldem 'gros gcig brdeg de rjes dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bskyed pa/ gdags pa'i rgyan gsum/ byugs pa'i rdzas gsum/ bgo ba'i gso gsum la rol pa gcig brdeg pad skor bzhi pad kho na/ 'cham dngos/

thams cad la grol bsdu/ phyag drug rdzas gsum/ gos gsum rnams kyi dngos gzhi'i 'cham rnams sbrel ba'i mtshams mtshams su grol bsdu dang pad skor mdzad/ zhal phyag dbu rgyan bskyed pa rnams kyi sngon du bsdu tshul/ glang lpags dang zhing lpags kyi mtshams mtshams su bsdu tshul/ thams cad kyi rjes rnams su mchongs pad mchongs rjes ldem 'gros gcig brdeg thod rlon la rna ba g.yon gyi rtsa bar dzam gsum byas la rol mo che ba drug la mdun nas bskor te rna ba g.yas su sleb pa dang / dzam gsum byas la slar g.yon du log grol bsdu bya/ glang lpags la g.yas gsig bzhi dang g.yon gsig bzhi/ spel ma bzhi rnams byas la grol bsdu bya ste kha do ra la blta ba kho na'o/ /zhing lpags la kha do ra'i phyir bltas la g.yas gsig bzhi/ yang kha nang bltas kyi g.yas gsig bzhi/ de nas spel ma bzhi rnams byas la grol bsdu bya/ stag lpags la skyed pa'i lta zur g.yas su dzam gsum byas la rol mo che ba bzhi la stag gi sham thabs dkri tshul gyi mdun nas bskor la g.yon du sleb pa dang grol bsdu bya ba yin no/ /rak+ta dang thal chen gyis byugs pa'i gnas ni/ smin mtshams mkhur mdzod g.yas g.yon ma le sna/ /skra mtshams smin ma gnyis dang smin mtshams mo/ /rdo rje khyung gshog la rol pa gcig brdeg pad skor bzhi dang / bsdu tshul/ 'cham dngos/ grol bsdu/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ 'khril sbyor yum bskyed pa la rol pa gcig brdeg pad skor bzhi pad/ bsdu tshul/ 'cham dngos rnams dang mtshams mtshams su grol bsdu dang pad skor re re/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes bskyod 'gros/ 'gying chen nas 'di'i bar gyi bzhi pad rnams la pad skor re re ka mdzad cing rol mo yang dal rang grags pa min tsam byed gsungs pa 'cham dpe chen mo rang na yod pas dgongs dgos so/ /de nas phyag brnyan gyi brjid 'cham rnams la rol pa gcig brdeg

de rjes rol mo lnga brdeg bzhi pad/ 'cham dngos/ grol bsdu/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes 'og ma la bskyod 'gros dang / gzhan kun la ldem 'gros gcig brdeg phra men gyi shon 'cham rnams la rol pa gcig brdeg de rjes rol mo bzhi brdeg bzhi pad/ 'cham dngos/ grol bsdu/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes 'og ma la bskyod 'gros/ gzhan rnams la ldem 'gros gcig brdeg sgo mtshams ma bzhi'i 'cham la shar phyogs ma gtogs pa rol pa bzhi brdeg mchongs pad dang 'cham dngos/ grol bsdu/ mchongs pad mchongs rjes byang ma la bskyod 'gros gcig brdeg dang / gzhan gsum la ldem 'gros bzhi brdeg go dam can gyi 'cham la rol mo 'theng brdung du bsgyur/ pad skor mchongs pad rol mo nyis brdeg gi ngang nas 'cham dngos/ dbang phyug ma'i las bzhi'i 'dur 'cham ni/ mtshan bzhi la rol mo 'theng brdungs/ mchongs pad/ 'cham dngos/ phra men bam̐ len gyi 'cham la rol mo 'theng brdungs/ pad skor mchongs pad/ rol 'gros/ yang pad skor mchongs pad/ 'cham dngos/ bam̐ brtag pa la rol mo 'then rkang / 'chams dngos/ pho rog rdo rje 'gros kyi 'cham la rol mo bzhi brdeg pad skor/ dzam/ 'cham dngos/ mgron spyan drangs ba/ bam̐ bsgral zhing bsha' ba/ 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlab pa/ ling ro 'bul zhing longs spyod pa rnams la rol mo lnga brdeg pad skor dang / 'cham stabs dngos/ de nas bstan skyong dang log 'gro ba'i 'cham ni gzhan dang 'brel chung bas/ 'dzogs chung ba'i phyir 'dir ma bris so/ /stangs stabs kyi 'cham tshul zur bkod 'phrin las bsam 'phel zhes bya ba sngar byas zin pas der blta bar bya'o/ /mgron spyan 'dren pa'i skabs su rang gi lus kyi g.yas zur g.yon zur/ yang g.yas zur dang g.yon zur gyi rgyab dbus rnams kyi nam mkhar lag gnyis g.yab cing smin mtshams thad kar lhod 'jog pa'i dmigs pa la/ zhi gnyis zhi ba'i lha phyogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/

khro bo chos skyong bsrung ma/ phur bsrung dam can rgya mtsho brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams spyan drangs par bsam mo/ /ling ro 'bul tshul ni dbus g.yas zur g.yon zur/ yang de'i rgyab gnyis rnams la 'bul tshul dang / de nas rang gi g.yas g.yon gyi spun grogs rnams la mgron bya ba'i tshul dang / de nas rang gis longs spyod tshul rnams byas la rang gi mi mthun phyogs thams cad dgra phyogs su bzlog par bsam la phur pa bsgril la kī la ya brjod do/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa/ /chos med rnal 'byor rigs sngags 'chang / /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /bris so phur bsrung kun dges shog /'dir ni gar 'cham lhongs su 'khyur pa rnams kyi brjed gso la yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra bar yod pas rtsis che bar mdzod/ don gnyer rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga lam̐// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub kyi bsdus don 'phrin las kun khyab/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
